commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "=== STEP 1: prepare backing store and first loop-backed PV ==="
sudo -n mkdir -p /var/lib/lvm-loop-data
sudo -n chmod 700 /var/lib/lvm-loop-data

sudo -n fallocate -l 1200M /var/lib/lvm-loop-data/disk0.img
LOOP0=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/lvm-loop-data/disk0.img)
echo "loop0=$LOOP0"

echo "=== STEP 2: create PV/VG/LV, filesystem, mount ==="
sudo -n pvcreate -f "$LOOP0"
sudo -n vgcreate vg_data "$LOOP0"
sudo -n lvcreate -n lv_data -l 100%FREE vg_data
sudo -n mkfs.ext4 -q /dev/vg_data/lv_data
sudo -n mkdir -p /srv/data
sudo -n mount /dev/vg_data/lv_data /srv/data

echo "=== STEP 3: baseline size ==="
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs vg_data/lv_data

echo "=== STEP 4: write test data and checksum ==="
sudo -n sh -c 'dd if=/dev/urandom of=/srv/data/payload.bin bs=1M count=50 status=none'
sudo -n sh -c 'sha256sum /srv/data/payload.bin > /srv/data/payload.sha256'
sudo -n sh -c 'echo hello-lvm-extend > /srv/data/marker.txt'
sudo -n cat /srv/data/payload.sha256

echo "=== STEP 5: add second loop-backed PV and grow VG/LV/FS while mounted ==="
sudo -n fallocate -l 1200M /var/lib/lvm-loop-data/disk1.img
LOOP1=$(sudo -n losetup -f --show /var/lib/lvm-loop-data/disk1.img)
echo "loop1=$LOOP1"
sudo -n pvcreate -f "$LOOP1"
sudo -n vgextend vg_data "$LOOP1"
sudo -n lvextend -l +100%FREE /dev/vg_data/lv_data
sudo -n resize2fs /dev/vg_data/lv_data

echo "=== STEP 6: post-grow verification ==="
mount | grep /srv/data
df -h /srv/data
sudo -n lvs vg_data/lv_data
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && sha256sum -c payload.sha256'
sudo -n cat /srv/data/marker.txt

echo "=== STEP 7: persistence across reboot (systemd unit + fstab) ==="
sudo -n tee /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh > /dev/null <<'EOS'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
for f in /var/lib/lvm-loop-data/*.img; do
  if ! losetup -j "$f" | grep -q .; then
    losetup -f "$f"
  fi
done
vgchange -ay vg_data || true
EOS
sudo -n chmod +x /usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh

sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/lvm-loop-setup.service > /dev/null <<'EOS'
[Unit]
Description=Attach loop-backed PVs and activate vg_data before local filesystem mounts
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-udevd.service
Before=local-fs-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/lvm-loop-setup.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
EOS

sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable lvm-loop-setup.service

LV_UUID=$(sudo -n blkid -s UUID -o value /dev/vg_data/lv_data)
echo "lv_uuid=$LV_UUID"
grep -q '/srv/data' /etc/fstab && sudo -n sed -i '\#/srv/data#d' /etc/fstab || true
echo "UUID=$LV_UUID /srv/data ext4 defaults,nofail,x-systemd.requires=lvm-loop-setup.service 0 2" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/fstab
cat /etc/fstab | grep srv-data -A0 || true
grep srv/data /etc/fstab

echo "=== STEP 8: sanity re-mount test (umount/mount via fstab) ==="
sudo -n umount /srv/data
sudo -n systemctl start lvm-loop-setup.service
sudo -n mount /srv/data
mount | grep /srv/data
sudo -n sh -c 'cd /srv/data && sha256sum -c payload.sha256'
df -h /srv/data

echo "ALL STEPS DONE"
